decision.title: XSLT streaming conformance: the draft's XSLT Streaming 4.0, snapshot documents, document-node types (packet 4.32)
decision.summary: Streaming analysis follows the new XSLT Streaming 4.0 specification, fn:snapshot copies the document ancestor with its base URI and unparsed entities, and document-node(element(N, T)) tests the annotation.

body.p: , after , , , , , , , , , . Verified as asks: the debug preset (xslt, xquery_lower_construct, function_library, evaluator_stream tests), clang-tidy on the changed files, the call-cycle check, the book examples (520 match), and whole XT40, XQ40 and XP40 runs with the release driver after each change, case by case. XT40 12,273 to 12,283 passed (98 wrong error), 245 to 235 failed, 0 errors, from a whole run at 19d3fb5 (stream-1's commits in between changed no outcome); XQ40 46,158 and XP40 32,815 as before. Commits d67e37f, 0378bf4, 0e8d459.

item.p: The newest draft moved chapter 19 into its own specification, XSLT Streaming 4.0 (qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-streaming-40/): XTSE3430 and the analysis are its sections 3 to 12; XSLT 4.0's chapter 19 is now accumulators. New comments cite it ("XSLT Streaming 4.0, 12.9"); the older "XSLT 4.0, 19.8.x" citations in src/xslt_streamability.c stand for the same rules (3.0's numbers) and are left until that file is next reworked.

Analysis: XTSE3155 (Streaming 4.0, 8), a function without parameters whose streamability is not unclassified; the verdict carries an error code (su-shallow-descent-901, error-3155a). fn:filter is filter(N, I) in the table of 12.9 and has no rule of its own, so its sequence argument is navigation whatever the function's signature (sf-filter-001, which the suite marks _WRONG); for-each, fold-left and for-each-pair keep their refinement (12.9.10, .13, .14).

Run time: fn:snapshot's document ancestor is copied as xsl:copy copies a document (XSLT 4.0, 20.4, 11.9.1): base URI and unparsed entities, by an internal row document-copy beside the key rows (sf-unparsed-entity-03, -04). document-node(element(N, T)) tests the element's annotation and nilled too (XPath 4.0, 3.2.7.1; it tested the name only: si-document-113, -114). input-type-annotations="strip" applies after xsl:source-document and xsl:merge-source validate (4.2, 4.2.1): a copy without annotations (streamable-147). The XSLT driver's unnamed principal package is the first module not of role secondary (su-filter-101, -102).

Memory stays bounded: a for-each with fn:snapshot over a 13 MB document of 400,000 records, release CLI: peak resident 8.5 MB streamed, 171 MB unstreamed, output identical; evaluator_stream_test passes under its 1 MB limits.

The draft or the suite decides (37 of the 54 failing streaming cases at the start; 9 are fixed, 8 left below): whitespace text nodes in assert-xml (the expected results are indented or drop text the stylesheet writes: sf-snapshot-0201 to -0209, accumulator-054, si-copy-of-801, si-for-each-807, stream-210, su-absorbing-201, -204); mixed numeric comparison is exact in F&O 4.0 (xs:double 4.32 ne 4.32: sx-gc-eq-016, -020, -021, -116, -120, -121, sx-if-213); map constructor duplicates are XQDY0137 in XPath 4.0 (sx-MapExpr-007, si-fork-814); [xsl:]type is XTTE1540 (25.1.2; si-copy-117, si-copy-of-117); lax validation of an undeclared element gives xs:anyType (F&O 4.0, 17.2.4; stream-013, non-stream-013, si-result-document-024); a sorted xsl:for-each-group in xsl:fork is streamable (Streaming 4.0, 12.6.19, 12.6.20; si-fork-953); E/@id is in document order (sf-reverse-001); the order of two trees is implementation-dependent (si-fork-118); FODC0005 is a "may" of fn:doc (stream-006, non-stream-006); no xsl:mode means no applicable accumulators (19.2; accumulator-073); a template of a package without visibility is private (accumulator-038); streamable-149's environment source is invalid before the stylesheet runs (the driver's validation, cvc code).

Not done: accumulator-061 (accumulator-after#1 in a global whose global context item is absent while streaming raises XPDY0002 where the test wants XTDE3350; 's absent focus of globals, medium); capture-206 (); merge-017, -054, -067 and the three merge-097 cases are not streaming causes.
